flags: acoustic_loglik.nc absent: acoustic layer not used

satcom_attrs.title: MH370 end-point probability implied by Inmarsat BTO/BFO + simple autopilot paths
satcom_attrs.method: SMC over 5 autopilot modes (LNAV, CTT, CMT, CTH, CMH) at constant Mach/FL with ERA5 winds; mode weights from SMC evidence (equal mode priors); end-of-flight mixture p = 0.80*p_uncontrolled + 0.20*p_glide
satcom_attrs.note: Each variable sums to 1 over the grid (mass outside the grid renormalised away; see outputs/satcom/summary.json). See outputs/satcom/README.md.

drift_attrs.title: mh370-open workstream B: log-likelihood of the MH370 debris evidence vs origin
drift_attrs.method: Markov chain from NOAA GDP 6-hourly drifters; presence-in-find-region during arrival windows; WA non-detection. See outputs/drift/README.md
drift_attrs.computed_region: cells within 300 km of the sea-level 7th arc; NaN elsewhere
drift_attrs.sources: GDP 6h doi:10.25921/7ntx-z961; NCEP/NCAR R1; Natural Earth; MH370 SIR 2018 Table 1.12A
